name_en: Mimi — triangle-folded dough dumplings simmered in miso with vegetables
summary_ja: 小麦粉の生地を正方形に切り、二つの角をつまんで三角にした「耳」を野菜と味噌で煮こむ富士川町十谷地域の一品。農具の箕に似た形が「福をすくう」に通じるとされ、正月元旦に歳神様へ供えると伝わる。
summary_en: Squares of wheat dough are pinched at two corners into a triangle and simmered in miso with vegetables — a dish from the Totani area of Fujikawa town. Its shape, likened to a winnowing basket, is said to symbolize scooping up good fortune, and it is offered to the New Year's deity.
source_title: みみ 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mogura uri no hiyajiru — a cold summer soup of a rare local melon-gourd
summary_ja: 130年前から自家採種で受け継がれてきた茂倉瓜を千切りにし、冷たい煮干しだしに味噌とみょうがを合わせてごはんにかける早川町茂倉地域の夏の汁。きゅうりより青くささが少なく、しゃきしゃきした食感と伝わる。
summary_en: The mogura melon-gourd, saved and replanted from seed for some 130 years, is julienned and dropped into cold sardine-stock miso soup with myoga, then poured over rice — a summer dish from the Mogura area of Hayakawa town. Less grassy than cucumber, with a crisp bite, it is said.
source_title: 茂倉瓜の冷や汁 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Yugao no miso shiru — bottle-gourd miso soup, a Fuji foothill summer staple
summary_ja: ひょうたんに似た長い形の「ながゆうがお」を薄切りにし、煮干しだしと味噌で仕立てる富士北麓地域の夏の汁。かんぴょうの原料とは別種で、淡泊な味わいがとろりとした食感とともに好まれると伝わる。
summary_en: The long, gourd-shaped 'naga-yugao', a bottle gourd variety distinct from the one used for kanpyo strips, is thinly sliced into a sardine-stock miso soup — a summer dish from the Fuji foothills, its mild flavor and silky texture said to be well liked.
source_title: 夕顔のみそ汁 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Inobuta nabe — a sesame miso hot pot of wild-boar-crossed pork
summary_ja: 雄いのししと雌豚を掛け合わせた「いのぶた」の肉を、ごま入り味噌汁で野菜やきのこと煮る三富地域の鍋。獣臭さがなく脂に甘みがあるとされ、戦後の狩猟文化を背景に飼育が奨励されたと伝わる。
summary_en: Meat from 'inobuta', a cross between wild boar and domestic sow, is simmered with vegetables and mushrooms in a sesame-miso broth — a hot pot from the Mitomi area, said to lack any gamey edge and carry a sweet richness in its fat, its breeding encouraged after the war on a base of local hunting culture.
source_title: いのぶた鍋 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
